Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 10814 of 2018
Applicant :- Ravindra Mourya And 2 Others

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Krishna,Govind Krishna,Jagadamba Gupta,Kuldip Singh Ya Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Maurya Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.

1. Heard SriKuldip Singh Yadav, learned counsel for the applicants, SriRajesh Maurya, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and Sri Brijesh Kumar Dwivedi, learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The present application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings pending before Judicial Magistrate, Azamgarh in Complaint Case No. 216 of 2017, Anita Mourya Vs. Ravindra and others u/s 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and the order dated 27.10.2017 thereby issued summon fixing 03.01.2018 thereafter fixed 03.04.2018 which is pending before Judicial Magistrate,
Azamgarh.

entities.text: Anita Mourya Vs. Ravindra and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicants is that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature.
Now, they have settled their dispute amicably and a written compromise dated 10.12.2019 has also been entered into between them.

It is further submitted that the aforesaid compromise has already been filed before the court below and a request has been made that on the Ravindra Mourya And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101458892/
1 basis of the written compromise, impugned proceedings may be quashed.
4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer on the ground that the aforesaid compromise is yet to be verified by the court below.
5.

entities.text: Ravindra Mourya And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid submissions of both the parties, the present application is disposed of with direction to the court below to verify the said compromise after summoning the parties within a period of two months from the date of receiving copy of this order.
After verification of the aforesaid compromise, court below will permit the parties to obtain certified copy of the same.
6. After verification of the compromise, court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding, in accordance with law.
7. For a period of two months, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
8. It is further provided that applicants are at liberty to file fresh application u/s 528 B.N.S.S., if required, to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified compromise.
